notes: Checking an estimate now fits on one screen: the food name, the numbers, how much you ate, the logged total and what Gemini assumed. Foods picked from search and Edit entry work the same way.
The swipe now says what it will log, like “Swipe to log 92 Cal”, with what that leaves for the day just above it. The Close button has gone: tap ✕ or swipe down.

Fixed switching between Per serving and Per 100g, which could turn a 140 g yoghurt into 140 servings (9,240 Cal). It now keeps the total the same, and tapping the option that's already on does nothing.
Refine keeps the meal, photo and favourite you picked, a menu pick can't be swapped for an older Gemini estimate, and a blank amount logs what the sheet shows instead of 1 g.
Fixed the backup reminder popping up even though you'd backed up recently, sometimes straight after exporting. It now counts from your last backup and only appears when one is due.
maintenanceNote: Generated by scripts/prebuild.mjs from package.json and src/release-notes.json. Bump the 4-part "version" in package.json by hand (npm version cannot parse it), edit src/release-notes.json, then npm run build.
